H.flight.start('docked', 0.35); H.flight.transit(); const a = H.flight.simulate(4.2, ['KeyW']); const g = H.flight.game; const f = g.frame; const wx = f.origin.x + g.player.x * f.tx + g.player.z * f.rx; const wy = f.origin.y + g.player.x * f.ty + g.player.z * f.ry; console.error('MID ' + JSON.stringify({ r: Math.hypot(wx, wy), back: H.ring.layout.radii.back, floor: H.ring.layout.radii.floorMid, hits: a.hits, last: g.collision.lastHit }))

H.flight.start('docked', 0.35); H.flight.transit(); const a = H.flight.simulate(9, ['KeyW']); const g = H.flight.game; const f = g.frame; const wx = f.origin.x + g.player.x * f.tx + g.player.z * f.rx; const wy = f.origin.y + g.player.x * f.ty + g.player.z * f.ry; console.error('THROUGH ' + JSON.stringify({ r: Math.hypot(wx, wy), back: H.ring.layout.radii.back, hits: a.hits, last: g.collision.lastHit }))

const L = H.ring.layout; const th = (-45 + 45) * h.DEG; const v = h.v3; const fr = h.frameAt(th); const pos = fr.out.clone().multiplyScalar(L.radii.floorMid + 5200).add(fr.along.clone().multiplyScalar(-2600)).add(v(0,0,1500)); const tgt = fr.out.clone().multiplyScalar(L.radii.floorMid).add(v(0,0,0)); H.setCine({ pos, fwd: tgt.sub(pos).normalize(), up: v(0,0,1), fov: 50, sun: { azimuth: th / h.DEG - 30, elevation: 35 } })

const L = H.ring.layout; const th = (-45 + 45) * h.DEG; const v = h.v3; const fr = h.frameAt(th); const pos = fr.out.clone().multiplyScalar(L.radii.back - 3000).add(fr.along.clone().multiplyScalar(1800)).add(v(0,0,900)); const tgt = fr.out.clone().multiplyScalar(L.radii.back); H.setCine({ pos, fwd: tgt.sub(pos).normalize(), up: v(0,0,1), fov: 55, sun: { azimuth: th / h.DEG + 150, elevation: 35 } })

const f = H.ring.k7.frame; const v = h.v3; const pos = v(f.origin.x + f.rx*9000 + f.tx*-9000, f.origin.y + f.ry*9000 + f.ty*-9000, 2600); const tgt = v(f.origin.x + f.tx*-8500, f.origin.y + f.ty*-8500, -200); H.setCine({ pos, fwd: tgt.sub(pos).normalize(), up: v(0,0,1), fov: 55, sun: { azimuth: Math.atan2(f.ry, f.rx)/h.DEG - 40, elevation: 40 } })

const f = H.ring.k7.frame; const v = h.v3; const pos = v(f.origin.x + f.rx*10000 + f.tx*12000, f.origin.y + f.ry*10000 + f.ty*12000, 3000); const tgt = v(f.origin.x + f.tx*11000, f.origin.y + f.ty*11000, -200); H.setCine({ pos, fwd: tgt.sub(pos).normalize(), up: v(0,0,1), fov: 55, sun: { azimuth: Math.atan2(f.ry, f.rx)/h.DEG - 40, elevation: 40 } })
